data.body: ADDITIVE SCHEMA EXTENSION REQUEST from 7f42-e41f-a501-4007: Two new optional fields per manifest entry needed: (1) source_files: array of source file paths used preferentially over parent ticket file_impact for 7f42's intent-header-source-check.sh source-symbol resolution; (2) deferred_test: bool (default false), when true suppresses intent_with_no_test at closure-time block evaluation. Both fields are ADDITIVE and non-breaking for 94ed's forward-compat-preserving consumers (94ed's spec explicitly requires unknown-field passthrough). Add to plugins/dso/docs/contracts/intent-allocation-manifest.md per-entry schema during 94ed implementation OR as a 94ed follow-on if simpler. Validation fixture: 7f42 SC5(h) verifies backward-compat where manifest entries omit both fields.
